<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Modules\Events\Support;

use App\Models\User;
use App\Modules\Events\Enums\EventState;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;

/**
 * Shared UI action model for event surfaces.
 *
 * Keeps capability + state + cancellation checks in one place so list/detail
 * and prepare surfaces do not drift into visible-action / denied-route UX.
 */
class EventActionAvailability
{
    /**
     * @return array<string, array{visible: bool, enabled: bool}>
     */
    public function for(User $actor, Event $event): array
    {
        $cancelled = $event->cancelled_at !== null;
        $canUpdate = $this->allows($actor, $event, 'events.update.team', 'events.update.global');
        $canPublish = $this->allows($actor, $event, 'events.publish.team', 'events.publish.global');
        $canCancel = $this->allows($actor, $event, 'events.cancel.team', 'events.cancel.global');
        $setupEditable = in_array($event->state, [EventState::DRAFT, EventState::PUBLISHED], strict: true);
        $canViewAutomations = $this->allows(
            $actor,
            $event,
            'automations.view.team',
            'automations.view.global',
        );

        return [
            'edit' => [
                'visible' => $canUpdate,
                'enabled' => $canUpdate && ! $cancelled && $event->state === EventState::DRAFT,
            ],
            'publish' => [
                'visible' => $canPublish && $event->state === EventState::DRAFT,
                'enabled' => $canPublish && ! $cancelled && $event->state === EventState::DRAFT,
            ],
            'prepare' => [
                'visible' => false,
                'enabled' => false,
            ],
            'cancel' => [
                'visible' => $canCancel,
                'enabled' => $canCancel && ! $cancelled && ! in_array($event->state, [
                    EventState::LIVE,
                    EventState::ENDED,
                    EventState::SUSPENDED,
                ], strict: true),
            ],
            'manageLanding' => [
                'visible' => $canUpdate && ! $cancelled,
                'enabled' => $canUpdate && ! $cancelled && $setupEditable,
            ],
            'manageRegistrationForm' => [
                'visible' => $canUpdate && ! $cancelled,
                'enabled' => $canUpdate && ! $cancelled && $setupEditable,
            ],
            'manageAutomations' => [
                'visible' => $canViewAutomations && ! $cancelled,
                'enabled' => $canViewAutomations && ! $cancelled && $setupEditable,
            ],
            'manageAudienceBoost' => [
                'visible' => $canUpdate && ! $cancelled,
                'enabled' => $canUpdate && ! $cancelled,
            ],
            'suspend' => [
                'visible' => Gate::forUser($actor)->allows('events.suspend.global'),
                'enabled' => Gate::forUser($actor)->allows('events.suspend.global')
                    && ! $cancelled
                    && $event->state !== EventState::SUSPENDED,
            ],
            'reactivate' => [
                'visible' => Gate::forUser($actor)->allows('events.suspend.global'),
                'enabled' => Gate::forUser($actor)->allows('events.suspend.global')
                    && ! $cancelled
                    && $event->state === EventState::SUSPENDED,
            ],
            'forceEnd' => [
                'visible' => Gate::forUser($actor)->allows('events.force_end.global'),
                'enabled' => Gate::forUser($actor)->allows('events.force_end.global')
                    && ! $cancelled
                    && $event->state === EventState::LIVE,
            ],
            'controlRoom' => [
                'visible' => $canUpdate
                    && ! $cancelled
                    && in_array($event->state, [
                        EventState::PUBLISHED,
                        EventState::PREPARING,
                        EventState::FAILED,
                        EventState::READY,
                        EventState::LIVE,
                    ], strict: true),
                'enabled' => $canUpdate
                    && ! $cancelled
                    && in_array($event->state, [
                        EventState::PUBLISHED,
                        EventState::PREPARING,
                        EventState::FAILED,
                        EventState::READY,
                        EventState::LIVE,
                    ], strict: true),
            ],
        ];
    }

    private function allows(User $actor, Event $event, string $teamCapability, string $globalCapability): bool
    {
        if (Gate::forUser($actor)->allows($globalCapability)) {
            return true;
        }

        return $actor->hasTeamPermission($event->team, $teamCapability);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Modules\Events\Policies;

use App\Models\Team;
use App\Models\User;
use Platform\Authz\Core\Contracts\PermissionSubjectInterface;
use Platform\Authz\Core\Enums\PermissionAction;
use Platform\Authz\Core\Enums\PermissionScope;
use Platform\Authz\Policies\ResourcePolicy;

/**
 * Story 2-1 — Event authorization policy.
 *
 * Extends ResourcePolicy so all scope resolution (including the SYSTEM_ADMIN
 * global bypass) flows through EffectiveScopeResolver rather than a hand-rolled
 * isSystemAdmin() role short-circuit (Rule 30).
 *
 * Capability strings:
 *   viewAny → events.view.{team,global}
 *   view    → events.view.{team,global}
 *   create  → overridden — @can('create', [Event::class, $team]) supplies Team
 *   update  → events.update.{team,global}
 */
class EventPolicy extends ResourcePolicy
{
    protected string $resourceName = 'events';

    /**
     * viewAny intentionally resolves `events.view.*` (not a separate `events.viewany.*`
     * capability) so any role that can view an event can also list — keeps
     * route(events.view.*) and policy in parity.
     */
    public function viewAny(PermissionSubjectInterface $user): bool
    {
        $scope = $this->scopeResolver->getEffectiveScope(
            $user,
            $this->resourceName,
            PermissionAction::VIEW->value,
        );

        return \in_array($scope, [PermissionScope::OWN->value, PermissionScope::TEAM->value, PermissionScope::GLOBAL->value], true);
    }

    /**
     * Story 2-1 — Admin + Co-host may create events.
     *
     * Overrides ResourcePolicy::create() to handle the Team argument that
     * Laravel passes via @can('create', [Event::class, $team]).
     *
     * When $team is supplied, the check is team-scoped against that team.
     * When $team is absent (e.g. base-class callers), falls through to the
     * scope resolver's current-team resolution — matching base behaviour.
     *
     * $team is nullable with a default to satisfy PHP LSP: the parent
     * declares create(User): bool with no second param, so any override
     * must keep it optional.
     */
    public function create(PermissionSubjectInterface $user, ?Team $team = null): bool
    {
        if ($team !== null) {
            /** @var User $user */
            return $user->hasTeamPermission($team, 'events.create.team');
        }

        // Fallback: no team supplied — resolve via EffectiveScopeResolver
        // (honours events.create.global for SYSTEM_ADMIN cross-team tooling).
        $scope = $this->scopeResolver->getEffectiveScope(
            $user,
            $this->resourceName,
            PermissionAction::CREATE->value,
        );

        return in_array($scope, [PermissionScope::TEAM->value, PermissionScope::GLOBAL->value], true);
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Feature\Events;

use App\Enums\UserRole;

use App\Modules\Events\Enums\EventState;

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Test;
use Tests\Feature\FeatureTestCase;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Group;

/**
 * Story 2-1 ATDD — Create Event flow.
 *
 * Covers AC1 (DRAFT creation + audit), AC2 (capability gate),
 * AC3 (validation), AC4 (workspace scoping).
 */
#[Group('events')]
#[Group('p0')]
class CreateEventTest extends FeatureTestCase
{
    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        // Per-process cache from PermissionCacheService can leak between tests
        // when RefreshDatabase recycles user IDs (a Co-host in test N becomes a
        // Billing Admin in test N+1 with the same user_id, but the cache still
        // says they have events.create.team). Wipe the cache between tests.
        \Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache::flush();
    }

    /**
     * Spin up an authenticated admin attached to a team.
     *
     * @return array{0: User, 1: Team}
     */
    private function adminWithTeam(): array
    {
        $user = User::factory()->create();
        $team = Team::factory()->create(['user_id' => $user->id]);
        $user->teams()->attach($team, ['role' => UserRole::ADMIN->value]);
        $user->forceFill(['current_team_id' => $team->id])->save();

        return [$user->fresh(), $team->fresh()];
    }

    private function cohostWithTeam(): array
    {
        [$owner, $team] = $this->adminWithTeam();
        $cohost = User::factory()->create();
        $cohost->teams()->attach($team, ['role' => UserRole::CO_HOST->value]);
        $cohost->forceFill(['current_team_id' => $team->id])->save();

        return [$cohost->fresh(), $team->fresh()];
    }

    private function billingAdminWithTeam(): array
    {
        [$owner, $team] = $this->adminWithTeam();
        $billing = User::factory()->create();
        $billing->teams()->attach($team, ['role' => UserRole::BILLING_ADMIN->value]);

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Modules\Events\Services;

use App\Models\Team;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Modules\Events\Enums\EventState;
use App\Modules\Events\Exceptions\EventStateLocked;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\LandingPage;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Registration;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Pagination\LengthAwarePaginator;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;

/**
 * Story 2-1 — central service for the Event domain.
 *
 * Phase 1 surface in this story: createDraft only. Subsequent stories
 * (2-2, 2-3a, 2-3b, 2-5, 2-6) extend this service with updateMetadata,
 * transition, publish (wrapper), cancel, suspend, reactivate.
 */
class EventService
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly EventAuthorizationService $authz,
        private readonly EventReadService $reader,
        private readonly EventStateMachineService $stateMachine,
        private readonly EventModerationService $moderation,
        private readonly EventLifecycleService $lifecycle,
        private readonly EventMetadataService $metadata,
        private readonly EventLandingService $landing,
        private readonly PublicRegistrationService $publicRegistration,
        private readonly PublicLandingService $publicLanding,
    ) {}

    public function getById(int $id): Event
    {
        return $this->reader->getById($id);
    }

    /** @param array{search?: string|null, date_from?: string|null, date_to?: string|null} $filters */
    public function getPaginatedByTab(string $tab, int $perPage = 25, array $filters = []): LengthAwarePaginator
    {
        return $this->reader->getPaginatedByTab($tab, $perPage, $filters);
    }

    /** @return Collection<int, Event> */
    public function getDashboardEventsForTeam(Team $team, int $limit = 5): Collection
    {
        return $this->reader->getDashboardEventsForTeam($team, $limit);
    }

    public function countEventsForTeam(Team $team): int
    {
        return $this->reader->countEventsForTeam($team);
    }

    public function countUpcomingEventsForTeam(Team $team): int
    {
        return $this->reader->countUpcomingEventsForTeam($team);
    }

    /**
     * Delegates to EventAuthorizationService::authorizeView.
     * Kept as a public method so EventController::show() and the edit flow
     * can call it without knowing the authz service directly.
     *
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     */
    public function authorizeViewAccess(Event $event, User $actor): void
    {
        $this->authz->authorizeView($event, $actor);
    }

    /**
     * List-access guard: actor may list events in their current team.
     *
     * Delegates to EventAuthorizationService::authorizeViewAny, which preserves
     * the current EventPolicy::viewAny behavior (events.view.global or events.view.team).
     *
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     */
    public function authorizeListAccess(User $actor): void
    {
        $team = $actor->currentTeam;

        if ($team === null) {
            throw new AuthorizationException('A team context is required to list events.');
        }

        $this->authz->authorizeViewAny($team, $actor);
    }

    /**
     * Combined edit-form guard: view capability + update capability + state check.
     * The state check (DRAFT + not cancelled) is NOT a capability — it stays here.
     *
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     * @throws EventStateLocked
     */
    public function authorizeEditFormAccess(Event $event, User $actor): void
    {
        $this->authz->authorizeView($event, $actor);
        $this->metadata->authorizeEventUpdate($event->team, $actor);

        if ($event->state !== EventState::DRAFT || $event->cancelled_at !== null) {
            throw EventStateLocked::for($event);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Landing/form-config guard: view + update capability, allows DRAFT|PUBLISHED.
     *
     * LandingSetup, LandingPreview, and RegistrationFormConfig surfaces are
     * writable in both DRAFT and PUBLISHED states, unlike the stricter
     * authorizeEditFormAccess which only allows DRAFT.
     *
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     */
    public function authorizeLandingFormAccess(Event $event, User $actor): void
    {
        $this->authz->authorizeView($event, $actor);
        $this->metadata->authorizeEventUpdate($event->team, $actor);
    }

    /**
     * Prepare-checklist guard: view + update capability.
     *
     * The prepare checklist is accessible in PUBLISHED state (it's the gate
     * to transition PUBLISHED→PREPARING). State validation is handled inside
     * EventStateMachineService during the actual prepare() call, not at the
     * component guard level.
     *
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     */
    public function authorizePrepareAccess(Event $event, User $actor): void
    {
        $this->authz->authorizeView($event, $actor);
        $this->metadata->authorizeEventUpdate($event->team, $actor);
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $metadata
     */
    public function createDraft(Team $team, User $actor, array $metadata): Event
    {
        return $this->metadata->createDraft($team, $actor, $metadata);
    }

    /**
     * Story 2-3b — Publish (DRAFT → PUBLISHED) with plan-gate triple-lock.
     *
     * Layer 3 of the triple-lock (FR80 / AR17): the service MUST re-check the
     * EVENT_PUBLISH entitlement even after the route capability + UI gate.
     * If the event team's plan does not grant PUBLISH, throws
     * PlanGateFailed (HTTP 402, JKM-EVT-1003).
     *
     * Idempotency comes for free from `transition()`'s same-state no-op.
     * Cancellation blocking comes from `transition()`'s cancelled_at re-read.
     */
    public function publish(Event $event, User $actor): Event
    {
        return $this->lifecycle->publish($event, $actor);
    }

    /** @return array{allowed: bool, reason: string|null} */
    public function publishReadiness(Event $event, ?User $actor): array
    {
        return $this->lifecycle->publishReadiness($event, $actor);
    }

    /** @param  array<string, mixed>  $payload */
    public function upsertLandingSetup(Event $event, User $actor, array $payload): LandingPage
    {
        return $this->landing->upsertLandingSetup($event, $actor, $payload);
    }

    /** @param  array<string, mixed>  $payload */
    public function upsertRegistrationFormConfig(Event $event, User $actor, array $payload): LandingPage
    {
        return $this->landing->upsertRegistrationFormConfig($event, $actor, $payload);
    }
    /** @param array<string, mixed> $payload */
    public function submitPublicRegistration(Event $event, array $payload, ?string $ipAddress): array
    {
        return $this->publicRegistration->submitPublicRegistration($event, $payload, $ipAddress);
    }

    /**
     * Story 4-17 — Resolve an Event by UUID for the delivery-logs surface.
     *
     * TeamScope bypass category: Authorization resolution — the route uses a plain
     * string parameter so TeamScope does not kill cross-team requests with 404 before
     * authorization runs. The event is found, then authorizeView enforces the team
     * boundary (403 for non-members, 200 for entitled members, bypass for SA).
     *
     * @throws \Symfony\Component\HttpKernel\Exception\HttpException 404 if no event with this UUID, 403 if not authorized.
     */
    public function resolveAndAuthorizeForDeliveryLogs(string $uuid, User $actor): Event
    {
        $event = Event::withoutGlobalScope(\App\Scopes\TeamScope::class)
            ->where('uuid', $uuid)
            ->firstOrFail();

        $this->authz->authorizeView($event, $actor);

        return $event;
    }

    public function findPublicRegistrationSupportEvent(string $eventUuid): ?Event
    {
        return $this->publicLanding->findPublicRegistrationSupportEvent($eventUuid);
    }

    public function findPublicLandingEvent(string $eventUuid): ?Event
    {
        return $this->publicLanding->findPublicLandingEvent($eventUuid);
    }

    public function findPublicRegistrant(Event $event, string $registrationUuid): ?Registration
    {
        return $this->publicRegistration->findPublicRegistrant($event, $registrationUuid);
    }

    public function resendPublicRegistrationConfirmation(Event $event, string $email, ?string $ipAddress = null): bool
    {
        return $this->publicRegistration->resendPublicRegistrationConfirmation($event, $email, $ipAddress);
    }

    public function suspend(Event $event, User $actor, string $reason): Event
    {
        return $this->moderation->suspend($event, $actor, $reason);
    }

    public function reactivate(Event $event, User $actor, string $reason = ''): Event
    {
        return $this->moderation->reactivate($event, $actor, $reason);
    }

    public function forceEnd(Event $event, User $actor): Event
    {
        return $this->moderation->forceEnd($event, $actor);
    }

    /** @return array{visible: bool, can_suspend: bool, can_reactivate: bool, can_force_end: bool} */
    public function moderationActions(Event $event, User $actor): array
    {
        return $this->moderation->moderationActions($event, $actor);
    }

    public function cancel(Event $event, User $actor, string $reason): Event
    {
        return $this->lifecycle->cancel($event, $actor, $reason);
    }

    public function transition(Event $event, EventState $next, User $actor, string $reason = ''): Event
    {
        return $this->stateMachine->transition($event, $next, $actor, $reason);
    }

    /** @param  array<string, mixed>  $changes */
    public function updateMetadata(Event $event, User $actor, array $changes): Event
    {
        return $this->metadata->updateMetadata($event, $actor, $changes);
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Feature\Events;

use App\Enums\UserRole;
use App\Models\Role;
use App\Models\Team;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Modules\Events\Enums\EventState;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Registration;
use App\Modules\Events\Support\EventActionAvailability;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route as RouteFacade;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Group;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Test;
use Tests\Feature\FeatureTestCase;

/**
 * Capsule T1 ATDD — Duplicate an event.
 *
 * The duplicate action must live in the shared event action model AND stand on
 * its own authorization: hiding the button is never the control that stops a
 * request.
 */
#[Group('events')]
#[Group('p0')]
class EventDuplicateActionTest extends FeatureTestCase
{
    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        // PermissionCacheService keys by user id; RefreshDatabase recycles ids
        // across tests, so a stale entry can grant a capability the current
        // fixture never had.
        Cache::flush();
    }

    /** @return array{0: User, 1: Team} */
    private function adminWithTeam(): array
    {
        $user = User::factory()->create(['email_verified_at' => now()]);
        $team = Team::factory()->create(['user_id' => $user->id]);
        $user->teams()->attach($team, ['role' => UserRole::ADMIN->value]);
        $user->forceFill(['current_team_id' => $team->id])->save();

        return [$user->fresh(), $team->fresh()];
    }

    /**
     * A member who may view the team's events but holds no create capability.
     */
    private function viewOnlyMemberOf(Team $team, string $roleKey): User
    {
        $role = Role::query()->create([
            'name' => 'Event View Only',
            'key' => $roleKey,
            'description' => 'Test-only role: event read access, no create capability.',
            'is_system_role' => false,
            'is_system_admin' => false,
        ]);
        $role->assignPermission('events.view.team');

        $viewer = User::factory()->create(['email_verified_at' => now()]);
        $viewer->teams()->attach($team, ['role' => $role->key]);
        $viewer->forceFill(['current_team_id' => $team->id])->save();

        return $viewer->fresh();
    }

    private function sourceEvent(Team $team, User $creator): Event
    {
        return Event::factory()
            ->inState(EventState::PUBLISHED)
            ->for($team)
            ->create(['created_by' => $creator->id]);
    }

    private function addRegistration(Event $event, string $email): void
    {
        (new Registration)->forceFill([
            'team_id' => $event->team_id,
            'event_id' => $event->id,
            'email' => $email,
            'email_hash' => hash('sha256', strtolower($email)),
            'full_name' => 'Prior Registrant',
        ])->save();
    }

    private function eventRowCount(): int
    {
        return Event::query()->withoutGlobalScopes()->count();
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // AC1 — named POST route on the event-scoped path, served by the module
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    #[Test]
    public function duplicate_route_is_a_named_post_route_on_the_event_uuid_path(): void
    {
        [$admin, $team] = $this->adminWithTeam();
        $event = $this->sourceEvent($team, $admin);

        $this->assertSame(
            url("/events/{$event->uuid}/duplicate"),
            route('events.duplicate', $event),
        );

        $route = RouteFacade::getRoutes()->getByName('events.duplicate');
        $this->assertNotNull($route);
        $this->assertContains('POST', $route->methods());
        $this->assertStringStartsWith('App\\Modules\\Events\\', $route->getActionName());
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // AC2 + AC3 — action model entry, shaped like its neighbours
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    #[Test]
    public function action_model_exposes_an_enabled_duplicate_entry_for_a_capable_actor(): void

     *
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $metadata
     *                                          Required keys: title, description, starts_at, ends_at, timezone.
     */
    public function createDraft(Team $team, User $actor, array $metadata): Event
    {
        $this->authz->authorizeCreate($team, $actor);

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($team, $actor, $metadata): Event {
            $event = new Event;
            $event->forceFill([
                'uuid' => (string) Str::uuid(),
                'team_id' => $team->getKey(),
                'state' => EventState::DRAFT->value,
                'title' => $metadata['title'],
                'description' => $metadata['description'],
                'type' => $metadata['type'] ?? EventType::WEBINAR->value,
                'starts_at' => $metadata['starts_at'],
                'ends_at' => $metadata['ends_at'],
                'timezone' => $metadata['timezone'],
                'registrant_capacity_limit' => $metadata['registrant_capacity_limit'] ?? null,
                // Story 3-11 / FR106 — persist organizer-set language; fallback to app default.
                'default_locale' => $metadata['default_locale'] ?? config('app.fallback_locale', 'en'),
                'created_by' => $actor->getKey(),
            ])->save();

            // E-PKG S5 — bind and burn one event credit atomically with the
            // event row (owner rule: credits bind at creation and never
            // release). Throws EventCreditExhaustedException, which rolls back
            // this transaction so no event is created, when an active paid team
            // is out of credits. A Free team with no consumable source proceeds
            // UNBOUND (the returned result's source is FREE_SANDBOX); publish /
            // go-live stay entitlement-gated so an unbound event can't go public.

                event: EventAuditEvents::EVENT_CREATED,
                description: "Event {$event->getKey()} created in team {$team->getKey()}",
                subject: $actor,
                target: $event,

                    'team_id' => $team->getKey(),
                    'event_uuid' => $event->uuid,
                    'type' => $event->type->value,
                    'timezone' => $event->timezone,

        });

        // Denied paths return ('denied', $reasonTag) WITHOUT touching the audit;
        // the post-tx block emits event.metadata_update_denied in its own tx with
        // try/catch + always-throw, so a logger failure cannot mask EventStateLocked.

            $fresh = $this->events->lockEventForServiceWrite($event->getKey());

            // A DRAFT event with cancelled_at set must reject metadata edits;
            // cancel is a flag, not a state, so isMetadataLocked() alone misses it.
            if ($fresh->cancelled_at !== null) {

                return [$fresh, 'denied', 'state_locked'];
            }

            $allowed = ['title', 'description', 'type', 'starts_at', 'ends_at', 'timezone', 'registrant_capacity_limit', 'default_locale'];

            if (! empty($applied)) {

            // state+audit invariant. Logger throw rolls back state.
            $this->auditLogger->log(
                event: EventAuditEvents::EVENT_METADATA_UPDATED,
                description: "Event {$fresh->getKey()} metadata updated in team {$fresh->team_id}",
                subject: $actor,
                target: $fresh,
                properties: [
                    'team_id' => $fresh->team_id,
                    'event_uuid' => $fresh->uuid,
                    'changes' => array_keys($applied),
                ],
            );

            return [$fresh->refresh(), 'changed', null];
        });

        [$fresh, $outcome, $deniedReason] = $result;

        if ($outcome === 'denied') {
            $description = $deniedReason === 'cancelled'
                ? "Event {$fresh->getKey()} metadata update denied (cancelled)"
                : "Event {$fresh->getKey()} metadata update denied (state {$fresh->state->value})";

class EventController extends Controller
{
    public function __construct(

    public function create(): View
    {
        if (! authUser()?->currentTeam) {
            abort(403, __('events.errors.no_active_workspace'));
        }

        return view('events::events.create', [
            'breadcrumbs' => [
                ['label' => __('events.list.title'), 'route' => 'events.index'],
                ['label' => __('events.create.title'), 'route' => null],
            ],
            // Defaults: tomorrow at the current top-of-hour for start, +1 hour for end.
            'defaultStartsAt' => ($startsAt = now()->addDay()->startOfHour())->format('Y-m-d\TH:i'),
            'defaultEndsAt' => $startsAt->copy()->addHour()->format('Y-m-d\TH:i'),

            'timezones' => $this->timezoneOptions(),

    public function store(StoreEventRequest $request): JsonResponse|RedirectResponse
    {
        /** @var User $user */
        $user = authUser();

        $team = $user->currentTeam;
        if (! $team) {
            abort(403, __('events.errors.no_active_workspace'));
        }

        try {
            $event = $this->eventService->createDraft(
                team: $team,

        } catch (EventCreditExhaustedException $exception) {
            if (! $request->expectsJson()) {

                    ->route('events.create')

                'error' => [
                    'code' => $exception->errorCode(),
                    'message' => $exception->getMessage(),
                ],
            ], $exception->httpStatus());
        }

        if (! $request->expectsJson()) {
            return redirect()
                ->route('events.show', $event)
                ->with('status', __('events.create.success'));

    public function update(UpdateEventRequest $request, Event $event): JsonResponse|RedirectResponse

                    ->route($this->eventRouteName($request, 'show'), $event)
                    ->withErrors(['update' => __('events.errors.state_locked')])

    {
        if (! $request->expectsJson()) {
            return redirect()
                ->back()
                ->withErrors([$errorBag => __('events.errors.domain_error')])
                ->with('reference', $e->errorCode());
        }

        return response()->json([
            'error' => [
                'code' => $e->errorCode(),
                'message' => __('events.errors.domain_error'),
            ],
        ], $e->httpStatus());
    }

    /**
     * @return array<int, array{id: string, name: string, offset: int}>
     */
    private function timezoneOptions(): array
    {
        $now = new DateTimeImmutable('now');
        $options = array_map(static function (string $timezone) use ($now): array {
            $offset = (new DateTimeZone($timezone))->getOffset($now);

            return [
                'id' => $timezone,
                'name' => sprintf('%s %s', self::formatOffset($offset), $timezone),
                'offset' => $offset,
            ];
        }, DateTimeZone::listIdentifiers(DateTimeZone::ALL));

        usort($options, static function (array $left, array $right): int {
            if ($left['id'] === 'UTC') {
                return -1;
            }

            if ($right['id'] === 'UTC') {
                return 1;
            }

            return [abs($left['offset']), -$left['offset'], $left['id']]
                <=> [abs($right['offset']), -$right['offset'], $right['id']];
        });

        return $options;
    }

    private static function formatOffset(int $offset): string
    {
        $sign = $offset >= 0 ? '+' : '-';
        $absolute = abs($offset);
        $hours = intdiv($absolute, 3600);
        $minutes = intdiv($absolute % 3600, 60);

        return sprintf('UTC%s%02d:%02d', $sign, $hours, $minutes);
    }

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Unit\Platform\Validation;

use Platform\Authz\Http\RouteCapabilityMiddleware;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Group;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Test;
use Tests\Unit\Platform\Validation\Support\RouteCapabilityValidationTestCase;

#[Group('platform')]
#[Group('authz')]
#[Group('validation')]
class RouteCapabilityRouteMappingTest extends RouteCapabilityValidationTestCase
{
    #[Test]
    public function sensitive_named_routes_are_explicitly_present_in_route_permissions(): void
    {
        $sensitiveRoutes = collect($this->namedRoutes())
            ->keys()
            ->filter(fn (string $name) => $this->isSensitiveRoute($name))
            ->values();

        $missingRoutes = $sensitiveRoutes
            ->reject(fn (string $name) => array_key_exists($name, $this->routePermissions()))
            ->values()
            ->all();

        $this->assertEmpty($missingRoutes);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function all_named_routes_using_route_capability_middleware_are_explicitly_mapped(): void
    {
        $guardedRoutes = collect($this->namedRoutes())
            ->filter(function ($route): bool {
                return collect($route->middleware())->contains(function (string $name): bool {
                    return $name === 'route.permission'
                        || $name === RouteCapabilityMiddleware::class;
                });
            })
            ->keys()
            ->values();

        $missingRoutes = $guardedRoutes
            ->reject(fn (string $name) => array_key_exists($name, $this->routePermissions()))
            ->values()
            ->all();

        $this->assertEmpty($missingRoutes);
    }
}
